name: Thrace Plastics Holding Company S.A.
summary: Thrace Plastics Holding Company S.A. provides technical fabrics and packaging solutions in the United Kingdom, European Union, the rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Technical Fabrics, Packaging, and Other segments. The company offers technical fabrics comprising woven and nonwoven geotextiles, geogrids, geocomposites, fabrics, membranes, films, nets, strapes, ropes, yarns, and fibers for construction, road construction, landscape and gardening, medical and hygiene, automotive, drainage and erosion control, furniture and bedding, sports and leisure, floor coverings, agriculture, horticulture, aquaculture, advanced use, filtration, and industrial use a…
